test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Had they not cleared the exam?

options.text: Is the exam not been cleared by them?
Have the exam not been cleared by them?
Was the exam not been cleared by them?
Had the exam not been cleared by them?

solution:
The correct answer is: **Had the exam not been cleared by them?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active form and we need to change it to the passive form.
 
• The given sentence is written in the past perfect tense and in the interrogative form.
 
• The past perfect tense in the active voice has the following structure: Had+subject+not+V3+object__
 
• The past perfect tense in the passive voice has the following structure: __Had+ object+ not + been +V3+Subject__
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct Passive Voice: *Had the exam not been cleared by them?*
